svg.title: How achievements work
svg.desc: Four stages left to right. Load a game, and its file is matched to the game's set. Play, and each frame the set reads the C64's memory: the trophy HUD shows two trophies lit, the next one up and one out for now. Your unlocks and best scores are saved, signed in. They are shared as Trophy Hunters, high scores and activity. Below, where you see it: the GAME tab, the trophy HUD in Retro Vibes, toasts, and attract mode.
svg.text: Each game with a set has trophies and high-score boards, checked as you play
in Retro Vibes, as you play
the boards when a game ends
